verdict.rationale: Claude Design is a SaaS design product that could plausibly offer official SDKs, so the axis applies, but the evidence pack never mentions an SDK or programmatic API for it. Probes for an OpenAPI spec all returned 404. The Claude Code handoff, /design-sync commands, and exports are adjacent integrations, not SDKs a developer can build against.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
